# High demand items: What to sell on eBay in 2026

According to eMarketer’s data, the volume of global retail e-commerce is expected to grow from $6.42 trillion in 2025 to $7.89 trillion in 2028. What’s more, half of the global population aged 14 and older will engage in online shopping by that year \[ [1](https://content-naf.emarketer.com/worldwide-retail-ecommerce-forecast-2025)\]. Grab your chance to capitalize on this growth by selling high-demand products to eBay’s 134 million active buyers worldwide.

![High demand items](https://export.ebay.com/_next/image/?url=https%3A%2F%2Fexport.ebay.com%2Febayhub_media%2Foriginal_images%2FBest_Offer.original.jpg&w=1920&q=90)

[Electronics](https://export.ebay.com/en/resources/seasonal-guide-for-ebay-sellers/high-demand-items/#Electronics)

[Toys and hobbies](https://export.ebay.com/en/resources/seasonal-guide-for-ebay-sellers/high-demand-items/#Toys-and-hobbies)

To facilitate the task for you, we have prepared a review of best-selling categories and subcategories that will help you maximize sales in 2026. Though short-lived fads can generate great profits if spotted early, it’s best to rely on long-term trends and product categories that are known for strong and steady buyer interest.

**Electronics** is the most popular category on eBay, accounting for 16.4% of all items on the marketplace.

**Apparel and accessories** take the second place with 13.8% of all eBay listings.

**Auto parts and accessories** take the third place with a 10.5% share \[ [2](https://www.zikanalytics.com/blog/ebay-statistics)\].

## Electronics

Electronics is one of the most popular categories in e-commerce. The growth of this sector has been slowing down in 2024 and 2025, but analysts forecast a slight rebound in 2026 (+1.5%) \[ [3](https://downloads.digitalcommerce360.com/Reports/022025_DC360_AmericanEcommerceForecast_SAMPLE.pdf)\]. In spite of a slower growth, the sales remain remarkably high: in 2024, e-commerce sales of electronics exceeded $74 billion in the US \[ [3](https://downloads.digitalcommerce360.com/Reports/022025_DC360_AmericanEcommerceForecast_SAMPLE.pdf)\].

Key products to consider:

#### **1\. Smartphones and accessories**

iPhones and flagship Android smartphones are among the trending products on eBay. Many buyers come to purchase the latest models, but you get higher margins when selling accessories such as protective cases, chargers, powerbanks, screen protectors, car mounts, etc. The sales of these lower-cost items remain consistent throughout the year because smartphone users seek to protect their devices from damage, express their personality via vivid graphics, and increase the overall convenience of use.

#### **2\. Tablets and accessories**

Tablets enjoy steady buyer interest because of their versatility. These devices are widely used for all kinds of purposes: entertainment, education, business, design, and other creative work. For many shoppers, tablets with bluetooth keyboards are affordable alternatives to laptops. Older-generation models often sell quickly to those who seek inexpensive options for children or casual use. And all those who buy tablets also need accessories such as protective cases, sleeves, styluses, keyboards, and stands.

#### **3\. Computers and components**

Sales in this category are driven by demand from remote workers, students, and gamers. Larger screens are more convenient for doing complex tasks, such as programming, working with spreadsheets, performing online research, etc. Selling complete desktop systems and laptops may be profitable, but margins are higher for separate components: graphics cards (GPUs), processors, SSDs, and memory modules. There is a great deal of tech lovers who prefer to upgrade their computers instead of buying new systems. The rise of cybersport and streaming is also fueling the demand for gaming hardware and accessories: customizable lightweight mice, headsets with immersive sound and noise cancellation, monitors with high refresh rates and low input lag, etc.

#### **4\. Wearable tech**

Smartwatches and fitness trackers are popular among fitness enthusiasts and wellness-focused buyers. These devices have become much more than simple step counters: they measure heart rate, sleep quality, oxygen saturation, stress levels, and even blood pressure. As for smart watches, they serve as a convenient extension of smartphones and allow users to pay bills, answer calls, read notifications and messages without taking out the phone. New models in the wearable tech category are released quite often, supporting buyer interest in the upgrade.

Virtual reality technology is developing, and VR headsets are now more accessible and versatile than a few years ago. That’s why there is an increase in demand in this category: buyers are attracted by lowered prices, newly released VR-compatible games, as well as opportunities for VR-based fitness and immersive education. Sellers can benefit from the growing interest in this category by listing not only headsets but also complementary accessories. Limited-edition models and bundles are also likely to sell well, especially when promoted around popular game releases.

Smart home technology offers us unprecedented convenience, energy efficiency, and security. In addition to this, prices have become more affordable recently, so smart home devices see steady demand on eBay. Consumers often start by purchasing simple things such as smart plugs and bulbs, and gradually add more advanced products such as smart home hubs, smart speakers, smart TVs, etc. To capitalize on this trend, eBay sellers can offer competitively priced bundles or multi-device packages.

On eBay, there is continued demand for popular consoles such as Sony PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X and S, and Nintendo Switch, as well as for older systems sought by collectors and retro gaming fans. Video games also sell well on the marketplace, with the highest prices on collector’s editions and discontinued titles. The recent trend on vintage and nostalgic gaming is driving the demand for older franchises, remade or remastered titles.

The most anticipated games of 2026 include: _Grand Theft Auto VI_, _Resident Evil: Requiem_, _Saros_, _Duskbloods_, _Marvel’s Wolverine_, _Stranger Than Heaven_, _Pragmata_, _Nioh 3_, _Fable_, _Gears of War: E-Day_, and _Onimusha: Way of the Sword_.

Refurbished electronics have a large audience on eBay —  there are numerous deal hunters and value seekers. However, to sell under the [eBay Refurbished program](https://www.ebay.com/sellercenter/ebay-for-business/ebay-refurbished-program), your account must be in good standing with eBay and meet certain criteria:

- eBay Top Rated Seller status
- At least 98% positive feedback
- Item not as described rate less than 4%
- Items not received rate less than 1%

To use the Certified Refurbished condition in your listings, you need to have a purchase order or letter of authorization from the manufacturer. The refurbished items you list on eBay must be fully functional, tested, and in pristine condition.

## Fashion

Fashion is the second top-selling category on eBay. Buyers from all over the world come to the platform to shop apparel and accessories — from luxury brands and designer pieces to affordable everyday options or vintage items.

However, selling clothes is associated with a higher return risk due to fit and sizing issues. To reduce returns, make your listings as detailed as possible. Include exact measurements (chest, waist, sleeve, inseam, etc.), add photos from multiple angles and on models of different body types. If you describe fabric type and stretch level, it will also help buyers make better purchasing decisions. For more tips, see our [article on how to sell clothes](https://export.ebay.com/en/manage-listings/the-perfect-clothing-ad/).

#### **1\. Jeans**

Jeans are a wardrobe essential with year-round demand across all generations. Popular brands like Levi’s, Wrangler, and Diesel sell well, while hot trends such as barrel leg jeans appeal to fashionistas. If you decide to sell denim pants, help your buyers minimize size mistakes by providing fit and rise information, as well as waist and inseam measurements. High-quality close-up photos of buttons and tags will prove item authenticity. Selling unauthorized copies is against [eBay’s counterfeit item policy](https://www.ebay.com/help/policies/prohibited-restricted-items/counterfeit-item-policy?id=4276).

Buyers often seek products by brands like Adidas, Nike, PUMA, Lululemon, and Under Armour since their sportswear is known to provide a high level of performance and comfort during training sessions. #### **4\. Sneakers**

Sneakers are one of the most active subcategories on eBay. Everyday shoppers search for trendy models by popular brands such as Nike, Adidas, New Balance, and Jordan, while passionate “sneakerheads” hunt limited-edition and vintage models, willing to pay premium prices for them.

**Please note:** new and pre-owned sneakers located within the US and priced $75 or higher are covered by [eBay’s Authenticity Guarantee program](https://pages.ebay.com/authenticity-guarantee-sneakers-seller/). When a buyer purchases a pair of such sneakers, they are first shipped to a team of independent authenticators for a multi-point inspection. After that, the package is delivered to the buyer via 3-day shipping. This program is free for sellers.

If your inventory is located outside the US, it’s not covered by the program. In this case, you can prove the authenticity of your sneakers by providing close-up photos of soles, logos, tags, boxes, and other key details.

Graphic T-shirts with pop culture characters, slogans and quotes are popular among younger buyers, while dress shirts and branded polos are for those who prefer business and smart casual style. ## Auto parts and accessories

[Vehicle parts and accessories](https://export.ebay.com/en/growth/pa/) are a booming segment on eBay Motors, generating over $10 billion in annual GMV. One out of every three global eBay shoppers buys products from this category. One of the reasons is that buyers can shop vehicle parts and accessories with confidence due to [eBay’s Guaranteed Fit program](https://export.ebay.com/en/growth/pa/ebay-guaranteed-fit-program/). It helps ensure that the purchased parts match buyers’ vehicles, thus reducing returns and increasing confidence. Add accurate [fitment data](https://export.ebay.com/en/growth/pa/vehicle-compatibility-fitment-guide-for-ebay-sellers/) to make sure your P&A listings are easy to find in filtered searches, and your conversion rates will increase considerably.

Exterior parts and accessories are bought by those who want to customize their vehicles or restore them after accidents. Popular products include front and rear bumpers, grilles, spoilers, rooftop racks, and mirrors. As global interest in wellness and self-care continues to grow, eBay sellers can benefit from this ongoing demand.

- New personalisation tool set to help sellers offer personalisation, without the hassle of managing requests manually
- eBay UK records growing demand for personalisation, with over 600 searches a day for ‘personalised’ items in 2020

Thousands of sellers offering personalised products on eBay UK will benefit from lower fees and new promotions until March 2022 to help them make the most of the growing demand for personalised gifts, eBay UK announces today.

In 2020 eBay UK recorded over 600 searches a day for ‘personalised’ items, with personalised mugs and glasses some of the most sought after customised and engraved products, with searches up 111% and 113%.

To help enterprising sellers to make the most of this growing trend ahead of Father’s Day on 20 June, fees to sell personalised items will be cut to 2% until 31st March 2022 (an average saving of 85%) and a new personalisation tool will be added to the site, helping sellers to offer customisable options without the hassle of managing requests manually.

From adding a name or initial to an item, to printing an image on a product, eBay’s new tool and offers will make it easier and cheaper for sellers to support personalisation requests, while helping shoppers to add a personal touch to their purchases.

In a further boost to those wanting to join or expand their store on eBay to make the most of the trend, sellers will also be able to list an additional 250 personalised products at no additional cost.

One small business owner already jumping on the trend is Victoria Eagle, who runs her eBay store Pegs & Pearls, selling personalised invitations and cards for every occasion.

**Victoria Eagle, owner of Pegs & Pearls, said:**“The invitations and cards industry was hit hard by the coronavirus pandemic, as events came to a complete halt. But the new personalisation tool will really improve the order process for my customers, and the reduced fees are welcome news for smaller businesses like mine that are on the road to recovery. Now that there’s hope for weddings and celebrations to go ahead this summer, I’m seeing sales surge and a huge demand for personalised invitations to help people stay connected and celebrate those special moments after more than a year apart from loved ones.”

**Alex Hiatt, Senior Category Manager for Home & Garden at eBay UK, commented:** “The demand for personalised and handmade gifts is booming as more and more shoppers want to put the personal touch on everything from jewellery and clothes to homeware and gadgets. That is why we’re making it easier for our sellers to jump on the growing demand, using technology and cutting seller fees to help shoppers put their unique spin on things.”

Further Information

# Zero Final Value Fees when you sell personalized items

Get all the details you need for personalized items upfront.

Ends 8/31/22.

![](https://ir.ebaystatic.com/pictures/aw/pics/promo/2021/1104/hero_mobile_640x422.jpg)

## Tips for setting up your personalized listings

1

Add the “Personalize” option to your relevant listings.

2

Make personalization instructions clear to your buyers.

3

Turn on the “message to seller” option.

## Get to know the new Item Specific feature

![Blue sliding scale icon.](https://ir.ebaystatic.com/pictures/aw/pics/promo/2021/1104/icon1.png)

Buyers can find your listings by filtering their search for personalized items.

![Blue magnifying glass icon.](https://ir.ebaystatic.com/pictures/aw/pics/promo/2021/1104/icon2.png)

Buyers can add their personalization details on the View Item page of your listings in certain categories.

![Blue message box icon.](https://ir.ebaystatic.com/pictures/aw/pics/promo/2021/1104/icon3.png)

Get personalization details and connect directly with your buyers with the “message to seller” feature.

## Your sale is protected

- Sell confidently with Authenticity Guarantee.
- Sellers are not required to accept remorse returns on personalized items.
- Create new listings and expand your personalization selection with confidence.

**What is the Promotion?**

**Final Value Fee**

Invited sellers (“Sellers”) who complete one or more sales of Qualifying Listings\* during the Promotion Period, pursuant to the terms and conditions set forth herein, will pay no final value fees on Qualifying Sales (the “Promotion”). To qualify for the Promotion, items must be
listed during the Promotion Period\*
**with the Personalize feature set to “Yes” (\*“Qualifying Listing”). Note: the Personalization feature is not available in all listing categories.**

The Promotion will apply to final value fees and $0.30 per order fees only. All other fees, including, but not limited to, insertion fees, international fees, and optional listing upgrade fees will not be eligible. All existing selling limits on your account (as well as
category and item limits) still apply, and may prevent you from creating the maximum number of listings in this Final Value Fee Promotion. View the
[everyday rate plan](https://www.ebay.com/sellercenter/selling/seller-fees)
for full details.


**Who’s eligible?**

This Promotion is available to Sellers who:

1. Received an invitation email and/or message in My eBay;
2. Create one or more listings with the “Personalize” setting under “Item Specifics” set to “Yes” and relevant personalization instructions provided; and
3. Meet eBay’s minimum seller performance standards. Please sign in to My eBay and view your Seller Dashboard to verify whether your account is currently meeting the standards.

**When is it?**

The Promotion will begin on Thursday, November 4, 2021, and will end on Wednesday, August 31, 2022 at 23:59:00 PT (11:59 PM plus 59 seconds), for listings on
[www.ebay.com](https://www.ebay.com/) (\*the “Promotion Period”).


**How do I get The Promotion?**

The final value fee discount will be automatically applied at the time of sale of a Qualifying listing. The $0.30 per order fee credit will be applied to your seller account within forty-five (45) days of the sale of a Qualifying Listing.

Please note that the Promotion may not be shown during the listing process. Instead, the discount will be reflected in the "Seller Account” section in My eBay, under the Account tab, or in your next invoice or financial statement.

**Restrictions & Exclusions.**

- The Promotion applies only to sales of listings with Personalize item specific set to “Yes.” The Personalization feature is not available in all listing categories.
- Listings that do not sell before the end of The Promotion Period will not qualify for The Promotion.
- All listings must comply with all applicable eBay policies, including eBay’s
[Duplicate Listing policy](https://www.ebay.com/help/policies/listing-policies/duplicate-listings-policy?id=4255)
that allows for the removal of duplicate fixed price listings.

- The Promotion is only valid for listings on the US site at
[www.ebay.com](https://www.ebay.com/).

- Fees for
[optional listing upgrades](https://www.ebay.com/help/selling/fees-credits-invoices/selling-fees?id=4822#section5)
(such as
[reserve price](https://www.ebay.com/help/selling/listings/selling-auctions/reserve-prices?id=4143), [subtitle](https://www.ebay.com/help/selling/fees-credits-invoices/selling-fees?id=4822#section5),
[Gallery Plus](https://www.ebay.com/help/selling/fees-credits-invoices/selling-fees?id=4822#section5), [listing in two categories](https://www.ebay.com/help/selling/listings/creating-managing-listings/adding-category-listing?id=4149), etc.) will still
apply. Please note: Not all features are available in all listing flows.


The Promotion is subject to U.S. laws, void where prohibited, not redeemable for cash, has no face value, and cannot be combined with any other fee offer. eBay may cancel, amend, or revoke The Promotion at any time, including in response to fraudulent activity.

## Top-selling eBay categories and products

eBay's marketplace spans hundreds of product categories, but the earning potential varies wildly. These **12 categories** consistently rank among the most sold items on eBay – and several of them work especially well with a print-on-demand business model.

### 1\. Smartphone accessories: A high-demand, high-margin category

![a dog next to a phone](https://files.cdn.printful.com/o/upload/bfl-image/cf/22947_l_01-Phone%20cases-min.jpg)

With [7 in 8 people worldwide](https://explodingtopics.com/blog/smartphone-stats) owning a smartphone, phone accessories are among the **best-selling items on eBay**. Demand never dips – buyers are always looking for ways to protect, personalize, and upgrade their devices.

Smartphone accessories are lightweight, easy to ship, and available at competitive pricing. They’re a practical, low-risk category for new and experienced eBay sellers alike.

**Top-selling items to sell in this category:**

- **[Phone cases and covers](https://www.printful.com/custom/phone-cases/personalized):** one of the most searched items on eBay. Custom phone cases are a strong entry point for print-on-demand sellers – Printful’s Catalog includes snap, tough, and biodegradable cases for the latest iPhone and Samsung models, so there’s no need to hold inventory.

- **[Earphone cases](https://www.printful.com/custom/tech-accessories/earphone-cases):** a fast-growing niche driven by the continued popularity of wireless earbuds.  Printful offers customizable AirPod cases – a solid add-on to bundle with phone cases.

- **Screen protectors:** a high-volume, low-cost staple that shoppers purchase repeatedly.

- **Cell phone chargers and cables:** an essential kit for all smartphone users.

- **Phone grips and mounts:** affordable accessories with strong impulse-buy appeal.\]


> **Pro tip:** Track new phone model releases closely. Being among the first sellers to list compatible accessories gives you an edge – early listings gain sales before the competition catches up.

### 2\. Clothing: Top-selling fashion items

Clothing is one of the best things to sell on eBay. Consumers shop for apparel year-round – from everyday basics to seasonal pieces. eBay's massive marketplace gives sellers access to buyers across every style, size, and budget.

What makes this category especially strong is the range: new items, vintage finds, or custom-designed pieces. There’s room for every niche, price point, and target audience.

New and growing eBay sellers start with these high-demand items:

- **[T-shirts](https://www.printful.com/make-your-own-shirt) and [hoodies](https://www.printful.com/custom-hoodies):** high-demand basics that work well for custom designs and branded apparel. Printful offers hundreds of t-shirts and hoodies. Choose from heavyweight cotton tees to all-over-print hoodies – all produced and shipped on demand.

- **[Footwear](https://www.printful.com/custom/footwear/personalized):** a competitive but highly profitable niche market with a dedicated customer base. Printful’s custom sneaker options let sellers list original designs without holding inventory across every size.

- **Vintage and secondhand clothing:** growing in popularity as more shoppers look for unique, [sustainable fashion](https://www.genevaenvironmentnetwork.org/resources/updates/sustainable-fashion/).

- **[Sportswear](https://www.printful.com/create-your-own-sportswear-brand):** consistently strong demand driven by health and fitness market trends.

- **[Sweatpants](https://www.printful.com/custom-sweatpants):** a best-selling item with steady demand across all demographics.

### 3\. Clothing accessories: Small items with big profit potential

Clothing accessories may be small, but they are some of the **most profitable items on eBay**. Buyers grab them to complete an outfit, follow a trend, or replace a worn-out essential. The repeat-purchase cycle makes this category a reliable revenue stream. Accessories are also highly flexible, low in shipping weight, and easy to scale across multiple niches.

**High-demand items in this category:**

- **[Hats](https://www.printful.com/design-your-own-hat):** a versatile, year-round accessory with broad demographic appeal. Printful’s Catalog includes embroidered dad hats, snapbacks, beanies, bucket hats, trucker hats, and more – all customizable.

- **Scarves, [neck gaiters](https://www.printful.com/custom-neck-gaiters), and [bandanas](https://www.printful.com/custom-bandanas):** seasonal best-sellers that spike during colder months and outdoor activity seasons. Printful offers custom neck gaiters and bandanas with all-over printing.

- **Belts:** a wardrobe staple with consistent demand across all styles and price points.

- **Sunglasses:** popular year-round, with strong seasonal peaks in spring and summer.

Before listing a product, estimate how much you’ll make from each sale. There are many eBay profit calculators that can help you estimate profit margins, but they all come down to a simple formula:

## Understanding eBay fees, payouts, and tax considerations

### eBay fees breakdown

The marketplace charges three main types of selling fees:

- **Insertion fees** don’t apply for your first 250 listings per month. After that, eBay charges **$0.35** per listing.

- **Final value fees** are a percentage of the total sale amount plus a fixed per-order fee. The exact percentage varies by category – most categories fall in the 12-15% range.

- **Optional listing upgrade fees** apply to premium features like bold titles, subtitle text, or scheduled listings that can improve your visibility.


The exact amount depends on the item’s price, category, listing format, and your seller performance. See eBay's [selling fees](https://www.ebay.com/help/selling/fees-credits-invoices/selling-fees?id=4822) page for detailed estimates.

### How eBay payments and payouts work

eBay manages all [payments](https://www.ebay.com/help/selling/getting-paid/getting-paid-items-sold-?id=4814) through its own payment system – buyers pay directly through eBay at checkout. This covers all major payment methods: **credit and debit cards, PayPal, Apple Pay,** and **Google Pay.**

Once a sale is made, eBay processes the payment and deducts any applicable fees before transferring the remaining balance to your linked checking account or debit card.

**Payouts usually arrive within two days** of confirming the buyer’s payment. You can set your payout schedule to **daily, weekly, biweekly, or monthly**. Need funds sooner? eBay also offers **express payouts for a flat fee of $2.**

### Tax considerations for eBay sellers

eBay sellers are responsible for understanding and meeting their [tax obligations](https://www.ebay.com/sellercenter/resources/tax-information), which vary by location and business scale. Consult a qualified tax professional to make sure you’re meeting your obligations and taking advantage of any available deductions.

Here are **three main tax-related responsibilities** eBay sellers should understand.

**Sales tax** In the **US**, eBay automatically collects and remits sales tax on behalf of sellers in states where it’s required. In the **UK and EU**, Value Added Tax (VAT) may apply depending on your location and annual revenue. You can validate what tax was collected on any transaction through your **eBay** [**Seller Hub**](https://www.ebay.com/help/selling/selling-tools/seller-hub?id=4095).

**Income tax** Any eBay revenue is generally taxable income. Maintain accurate records of sales and expenses, regardless of your business scale.

**Import charges** Overseas buyers may face import duties and taxes upon delivery. Being upfront about potential charges helps avoid disputes and negative reviews.
